model.quantization: ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION with NVFP4 target expert layers 3-44 and MXFP8 MTP expert layer 45

runtime.image_policy: Use the immutable image digest on all ranks. The profile verifies the image ID, source labels, model files, source-built NCCL binary, and installed vLLM lease contract before launch.

evidence.conditions: The cache-disabled runtime profile uses the same immutable SparkCache image, target, BF16 DFlash2, TP4/DCP1, scheduler, graph, native prefix-cache, chunked-prefill, asynchronous scheduling, Triton KDA prefill, and source-built NCCL settings as the SparkCache composition while omitting only the external key-value connector.
evidence.measurement: The image digest was launched on four directly cabled NVIDIA DGX Spark systems. A deterministic semantic canary exercised generation after startup, and vLLM metrics, resolved container arguments, RDMA state, container state, and fatal-log patterns were inspected on every rank.
evidence.result: The semantic canary completed in 2.703 seconds with finish reason stop and semantic_match true. DFlash emitted 231 draft tokens from 33 drafts. Every rank exposed 24 RTS VLLM::Worker RDMA queue pairs and the same image ID. SparkCache emitted no connector log lines, external-cache queries remained zero, and no preemptions, restarts, OOMs, or fatal-log matches occurred.
evidence.conclusion: The immutable SparkCache image serves GLM-5.3 Flash with BF16 DFlash2 at TP4/DCP1 when the external connector is omitted.
limitations: The receipt is a functional startup and semantic validation, not a throughput or soak qualification.
The target repository does not identify its base-checkpoint revision.
FlashKDA prefill and InstantTensor checkpoint loading are unsupported by the source-built image.
The optional deep_ep import emits a duplicate-NCCL warning before vLLM selects the source-built NCCL library.
